name: M27 IAR
description:
A much ruggedized variant of the Eisenmarkian M416 adopted by Grand Federation in role of a Squad Automatic Weapon issued to troops.
Sustainable firerate with manageable accuracy due to a heavier barrel and extra reserve ammo, but also suffers from lower-than-average power and magazine size in class.
''I have been trained by your Government to be a weapon. Trained to kill and destroy. All in the name of Liberty and Justice.''

Model submitted by Rialag.
